Name: JUMP_SPECIFY_ALT_PARAM_ST
Description: Altitude jumps launched from jump pads in missions. A map's BigJump region names the row with its Jump Specify Alt Param ID: when the AC jumps inside the region, the climb uses this row. Each field replaces the AC's normal jump value only when it is 0 or more; a field below 0 keeps the normal value, and a missing row keeps all of them. 0 is a real value, not 'unset'. Retail rows are named after their map (for example 3300010 for m03_30_00_00); every row used by a pad climbs straight up with gravity 1. Row 100 is the only one with horizontal values and no pad uses it; rows 99991001 to 99991003 are test rows.

Fields.Name: Goal Altitude
Fields.Description: Height above the jump start point that the vertical ascent climbs to. In metres. Below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail pads: 200 to 550.

Fields.Name: Gravity Multiplier
Fields.Description: Gravity multiplier applied during the vertical ascent jump. Below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Previous Horizontal Speed Carry-Over
Fields.Description: Multiplier for how much of the previous horizontal speed is kept when the vertical ascent starts. 0 keeps none of it; below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail pads: 0 (row 100: 0.5).

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal speed during the vertical ascent jump. In kilometres per hour. 0 most likely allows no horizontal movement, so the AC climbs straight up; below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail pads: 0 (row 100: 500).

Fields.Name: Horizontal Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal acceleration during the vertical ascent jump. In metres per second squared. Below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail pads: 0 (row 100: 800).

Fields.Name: Diagonal Jump: Middle Angle
Fields.Description: Intermediate ascent angle for a diagonal jump, chosen from the stick input when the jump starts. In degrees. Below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail pads: 0 (row 100: 25).

Fields.Name: Diagonal Jump: Maximum Angle
Fields.Description: Maximum ascent angle for a diagonal jump, chosen from the stick input when the jump starts. In degrees. Below 0 keeps the AC's normal jump value. Retail pads: 0 (row 100: 75).
